milestone: Faculty Cohort, Workload Scope and Evaluation-Policy Qualification

rows.current_evidence: Legacy preference keys control normal runtime membership; supplied eligible faculty need not submit preferences.
rows.decision: R1 roster-first term/scope snapshot; optional preference overlay. Department identifies participants/exclusion reasons, authoritative profiles and order; adviser approves cohort in evaluation.
rows.qualifiers: Already verified (current gap); Recommended but unapproved; Requires institutional confirmation; Requires adviser confirmation; Requires implementation; Requires additional testing.

rows.current_evidence: User creation binds login identity, not GA participation; read-only metadata projects the existing pool.
rows.decision: Keep accounts, faculty identity, term participation and scheduling eligibility distinct. Do not enroll/un-enroll based on preference or login activity.
rows.qualifiers: Already verified (separate paths); Recommended but unapproved; Requires institutional confirmation; Requires implementation; Requires additional testing.

rows.current_evidence: OptionB allowances actively lower targets; non-teaching activities are not scheduled.
rows.decision: Explicit W-B versus W-T decision; no implicit institutional/adviser approval. Thesis scope, inputs/outputs and method must match the chosen rule.
rows.qualifiers: Already verified (software); Requires institutional confirmation; Requires adviser confirmation; Requires implementation (if changes chosen); Requires additional testing.

rows.current_evidence: Model target24 minus allowances; warning30 and ceiling40; overlapping settings are not normal-model authority. Missing release rows default zero.
rows.decision: Confirm limits, credit units, missing/invalid/fractional values, zero targets and configuration precedence. Replace unknown defaults only under approved data contract.
rows.qualifiers: Already verified (current behavior); Requires institutional confirmation; Requires adviser confirmation; Requires implementation; Requires additional testing.

rows.current_evidence: Original full fitness500 balanced versus475 concentrated; all other components zero and both hard-valid.
rows.decision: Retire claims that rounded bands guarantee equity. Select independent approved fairness definition before scorer changes.
rows.qualifiers: Already verified; Recommended but unapproved; Requires institutional confirmation; Requires adviser confirmation; Requires implementation; Requires additional testing.

rows.current_evidence: L ties the equal-target pair; Q and V improve its fairness ordering but disagree for unequal targets.
rows.decision: L insufficient alone; compare Q squared relative shortfall with V overload/shortage/fulfillment-spread ordering. Weight/priority and preference tradeoffs remain undecided.
rows.qualifiers: Already verified (analytical controls only); Requires institutional confirmation; Requires adviser confirmation; Requires implementation; Requires additional testing.

rows.current_evidence: Eligibility-forced `[4,0]` passes, balanced ineligible assignment rejects, regardless of proposed lower score.
rows.decision: Keep eligibility, fixed commitments, completeness, hard ceilings and conflict checks mandatory; expose unavoidable imbalance without automatic relaxation.
rows.qualifiers: Already verified; Recommended but unapproved (diagnostics); Requires institutional confirmation; Requires implementation; Requires additional testing.

rows.current_evidence: Specialization is descriptive; explicit course eligibility is hard.
rows.decision: Keep permission separate; select reporting-only/tie-break/weighted soft alignment among eligible instructors, approved taxonomy and exception authority.
rows.qualifiers: Already verified; Recommended but unapproved; Requires institutional confirmation; Requires adviser confirmation; Requires implementation; Requires additional testing.

rows.current_evidence: Retained faculty/room false flags reopen on reset; section flags and V2 removed slots survive.
rows.decision: Separate immutable effective availability from mutable occupancy. Confirm closure sources/recurrence and revocation before implementing.
rows.qualifiers: Already verified; Recommended but unapproved; Requires institutional confirmation; Requires implementation; Requires additional testing.

rows.current_evidence: Existing hard validators and descriptive reports are not a complete quality evaluation protocol.
rows.decision: Freeze cohort/denominators, unknown/external scope, scarcity labels, independent fairness/alignment metrics, comparators and all-attempt outcomes.
rows.qualifiers: Already verified (audit boundary); Recommended but unapproved; Requires adviser confirmation; Requires institutional confirmation (data/policy); Requires implementation; Requires additional testing.

rows.current_evidence: Current V1/V2 checkpoint validation binds source/input/policy; retained historical artifacts stay unchanged.
rows.decision: Any future roster/score/calendar change needs explicit versioning and strict compatibility tests; no fingerprint spoofing, rescoring or silent migration.
rows.qualifiers: Already verified (current D10 continuation plus preserved prior V1 evidence); Recommended but unapproved (future policy); Requires implementation; Requires additional testing.

rows.decision: Keep production blocked. No fictional policy test, printout, Chair role label or disposable PostgreSQL pass supplies real institutional authority.
rows.qualifiers: Already verified; Requires institutional confirmation; Requires implementation; Requires additional testing.
